{{Quote|Your mother should have obeyed my orders and drowned you when she had the chance."<br /> "I ended Mother's suffering long ago, but your torment is just beginning.|Dramath to Tenebrae|<ref name="KOET">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>}}
'''Tenebrae's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] farmer and the mother of [[Tenebrae]] who later became the Sith Emperor, and the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Tenebrae's adoptive father]].

==History==
In [[5107 BBY]] her son [[Tenebrae]] discovered that he was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Her [[Tenebrae's adoptive father|husband]] confronted her about Tenebrae's [[Force power/Legends|power]], to which she admitted that she had an affair with the [[Dramath|ruling]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Her husband attacked her in a rage, and she was saved by her son, who [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|snapped]] his adoptive father's neck with a mere thought. 

Dramath mentioned her again when he told Tenebrae that she should have killed her son under his orders by drowning him. Tenebrae claimed to have ended his mother's suffering long ago.

==Behind the scenes==
Tenebrae's mother was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
